stories.title: US, China, EU: three paths to regulating AI
stories.simple_summary: The United States, China, and Europe are each creating their own different rules for how AI companies must operate. Each region is taking a different approach rather than working together.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly for businesses that sell internationally — they may need to follow different rules in different countries. For a local small business, you likely won't notice this directly.

stories.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
stories.simple_summary: An investor named Arthur Hayes thinks a lot of money being spent on AI right now is being wasted, and he's betting money on what he thinks will be the next big thing in technology.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: OpenAI Releases Findings on 377 Math Problems, Further Roiling Field
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI tested their AI system on 377 difficult math problems and released the results. This is causing some debate in the field about how well these systems actually work.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to people studying AI and technology experts — it doesn't directly affect everyday users or small businesses.

stories.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, Google stop short of AI safety guarantee
stories.simple_summary: Major AI companies (OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and Google) refused to promise that their AI systems are completely safe and won't cause harm.
stories.why_it_matters: This shows these companies aren't fully committing to safety promises, which is something to know when you use their tools, but they're still generally usable for normal work.

stories.title: Ex-Ramp engineers raise $20M for platform Melius after scrapping their first product
stories.simple_summary: A group of engineers started a new company called Melius that uses AI to automatically create ads and marketing campaigns for you, instead of helping you manage existing ads.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run ads for a small business, this tool might eventually save you time by automatically designing ads, but it's still a startup that's just getting started.

stories.title: Read the charter for the White House’s ‘Super Intelligence Force’
stories.simple_summary: The White House created a group called the 'Super Intelligence Force' to help the government handle AI technology, and they released their plan for what this group will do.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to policy experts and large businesses — it shows the government is paying attention to AI, but most small businesses won't be directly affected.

stories.title: How AI decision models could change content moderation
stories.simple_summary: A company called Musubi created a new AI tool that can decide which comments or posts to remove from websites more quickly and efficiently.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly for social media companies and website owners who moderate comments — most small business owners won't interact with this directly.

stories.title: AI computing startup Lambda to raise $4B ahead of planned IPO
stories.simple_summary: A computing company called Lambda (backed by Nvidia) is raising 4 billion dollars and planning to sell stock to the public in 2027. This is a high-stakes investment story.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The next hurdle for AI agents: getting websites to let them in
stories.simple_summary: AI assistants are being developed that can do things like shop online, book flights, and make reservations for you, but many websites are blocking these bots to prevent them from accessing their systems.
stories.why_it_matters: In the future, you might use an AI helper to do online errands for you, but right now websites are preventing this from working.

stories.title: Georgia Tech Announces New Online Master’s Degree in Artificial Intelligence
stories.simple_summary: Georgia Tech University is now offering a college degree you can earn online that focuses on teaching students about artificial intelligence.
stories.why_it_matters: If someone wants to learn AI skills or change careers into technology, this is an option, but it's mainly relevant to students and people looking to be trained.

stories.title: Hark releases an AI personal assistant with a focus on privacy
stories.simple_summary: A company called Hark created a personal AI assistant that focuses on protecting your privacy — meaning it tries to collect less information about you than other AI assistants do.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're worried about privacy, this shows some AI tools are starting to offer privacy protections, but it's still a brand-new product.

stories.title: DOJ Staff Must Refer to AI as ‘Super Intelligence’ in Court (1)
stories.simple_summary: The Department of Justice told its staff to use the term 'Super Intelligence' instead of 'AI' when talking in court cases.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly a government naming rule — nothing that affects ordinary people or small business owners.
